title: kbmon --events exports a kb.sprint root span over a sprint's kb.item spans once every item with a run has ended it
goal: kbmon --events exports a kb.sprint root span for each sprint, from the first move of its first item's run to the last move of its last, with an id derived from the sprint id and the sprint as an attribute; it exports the span once, when every item of the sprint that has a run key has ended its run (landed or released) and not before; the kb.item span of a sprint's item has the kb.sprint span as its parent and shares its trace with it and with its kb.worker and kb.landing children; the kb.item span of an item with no sprint stays the root of a trace of its own; the adapter sends the kb.sprint span as it sends the other spans

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
def story(title): return re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', title, '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
a, b, lone = story('A'), story('B'), story('Lone')
def plant(**sprints):
    for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
        d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
        if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
        if d['id'] in sprints:
            d['status'] = 'doing'
            if sprints[d['id']]: d['sprint'] = sprints[d['id']]
        json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
    g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted')
def walk(item, *states): return [c('transition', 'run/' + item, '--to', s).returncode for s in states]
def events(*extra):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/kbmon.py', '--events', '--root', T, '--store', S, *extra], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    try:
        return json.loads(r.stdout)
    except ValueError:
        return {'spans': [], 'cursor': ''}
def spans(doc, name): return [s for s in doc['spans'] if s['name'] == name]
RUN = ('claimed', 'working', 'returned', 'landing', 'landed')
plant(**{a: sp, b: sp})
walk(a, *RUN); walk(b, *RUN)
doc = events()
roots = spans(doc, 'kb.sprint')
items = [s for s in spans(doc, 'kb.item') if s['attributes'].get('item') in (a, b)]
ok = (len(roots) == 1 and 'parent' not in roots[0] and roots[0]['attributes'].get('sprint') == sp and len(items) == 2
      and roots[0]['start'] <= min(s['start'] for s in items) and roots[0]['end'] >= max(s['end'] for s in items))
print('kb.sprint', [(s['id'], s['attributes'].get('sprint'), s.get('parent')) for s in roots], 'kb.item', len(items))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: kbmon --events exports a kb.sprint root span for each sprint, from the first move of its first item's run to the last move of its last, with an id derived from the sprint id and the sprint as an attribute
it exports the span once, when every item of the sprint that has a run key has ended its run (landed or released) and not before
the kb.item span of a sprint's item has the kb.sprint span as its parent and shares its trace with it and with its kb.worker and kb.landing children
the kb.item span of an item with no sprint stays the root of a trace of its own
the adapter sends the kb.sprint span as it sends the other spans

notes: Premise: with two items of one sprint walked claimed to landed with coord.py transition, `kbmon.py --events` gives two kb.item spans (each with its sprint attribute) and no kb.sprint span (check 0 prints 'kb.sprint [] kb.item 2'). Builds on ST-3bmmg73g's run spans in mon_events.run_records and waits for ST-zlzvqz2w, which makes dispatch pass the trace id and the kb.worker span id of the run as TRACEPARENT: this story changes the trace id of a sprint's items from the item's own hash to one derived from the sprint id (span_id('kb.sprint-' + SP)), so the dispatch's TRACEPARENT must use the same function; add bl_dispatch.py to touches at claim if ST-zlzvqz2w computes the id there. Plan 2026-10-24 (night run), choices made in place of the operator: (1) the sprint span is emitted in the export that emits the last kb.item span of the sprint, when each item of the sprint with a run key has a last move of landed or released (items with no run key, such as the sprint's review and research stories before reconcile, are ignored; after `runs --reconcile` their landed moves make them count, and the span's end is then the last of them); a late export after `close` has no sprint attribute, as for kb.item today. (2) The span's id is its trace id, as the kb.item root is today; its status is ok; it carries the attributes sprint and items (the number of kb.item spans). (3) An item whose run was cut at refused and continues is one more kb.item span with the same parent. The adapter (otel/kbmon_otel.py) sends every span of --events, so check 3 may pass without a change there. Filed 2026-10-24 (night run) as one of the three later stories EP-nij36lt7 names; approved by the operator.
